{{Quote|Like the Emperor, we draw power from the suffering and death of others.|Commander Rayfel|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Krannus]] founded a '''death cult''' that worshiped the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], believing that their ruler would grant them eternal life if they [[Death/Legends|died]] in his service. Krannus and his cult attempted to detonate the power core of the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], but the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] stopped the cult before the core could detonate.
